name: parallelize the computation across multiple processes
definition: Split the per-k subsample work across worker processes controlled by an n_jobs argument so increasing jobs changes execution behavior/timing.
failure_mode: Parallel method runs everything on one process, failing speedup/timing checks.

name: re-run the processing pipeline and inspect the output file to confirm the fix
definition: Rerun the corrected script and view the generated file to verify the transformation values and record count.
failure_mode: Uncorrected transformation leaves wrong values or malformed lines
